flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4175/app?demo then Press Run again on "Bump the checkout form to the new inputs".
Check that it is now under Kane is checking and says "Kane is checking this pull request again."
Press Fix with Claude on "Make the free shipping threshold easier to read".
Check that it is now under Claude is fixing and says Claude is fixing Free shipping from €50.

Do each step once, the way it is described. If a click or a key press does something other than what the step expects, the check fails: @v16:"don't retry it, and don't reach the goal another way (other buttons, links, keyboard shortcuts, typing the URL)." Waiting for a slow page to load is fine.
